content.text: I read all inputs and every draft section, then built a limitation-by-limitation ledger against the disclosure and the single USER passage in the conversation.

input.summary: Full preflight completed. I traced all 17 claims limitation by limitation (claims 1-10 apparatus, 11-13 installed assembly, 14-17 method), all 28 entries of the numeral ledger (10-66, with 28 unused and no numeral carrying two meanings), all six figure briefs and their numeral placement targets, the Brief Description of the Drawings, the Field, Summary, Detailed Description and Abstract, against the affirmative inventor text in input/disclosure.md and the single USER passage in input/conversation.md. Every apparatus limitation traces to an exact affirmative passage: semicircular halves, hinge end and latch end, three radial jaw carriages in radial guides, pivoting concave jaw pads that avoid a tool-specific diameter, segmented cam ring in an annular guide with one segment per frame half, complementary hinge-end and latch-end drive faces coupled by closure, followers in respective oblique slots, wedge on a ring drive face, limited stroke, outward carriage springs, first holding position and second over-center position, force-limiting spring stack between handle and wedge, indicator pin moving relative to a fixed edge of the latch housing over a predetermined compression range, the non-measuring character of the indicator, the optional mounting boss outside the annular guide that does not participate in synchronization, and the install and remove sequences. Claim 6 and the corresponding description sentence about equal inward travel trace to "synchronized inward travel of all three jaw carriages" read with "rather than forcing one jaw farther than the others". Internal consistency checks pass: 32/44/48 belong to the upper segment carried by upper half 12 and 34/46/50 to the lower segment carried by lower half 14, matching FIG. 1 (hinge left, latch right), FIG. 3 (32 upper, 34 lower) and FIG. 6 (44/46 left junction, 48/50 right junction); every numeral in each brief is used in the description with a consistent figure reference; there are no section views and so no section-line designations to reconcile; and no drafting note, placeholder, open question, unresolved alternative or internal comment survives in the application text. The FIG. 3 drive-face position disclaimer and its FIG. 6 cross-reference stay confined to the figure briefs and are not verbalized in the Brief Description or the Detailed Description, and no "by way of example" or "any closed outline" language was added to the application text to justify a renderer's choice. The stray YOU passage in the conversation about a "self-adhering layer with a microsuction surface" was correctly not carried into any draft section. One untraced item remains: the FIG. 5 spring bullet adds a mounting relationship (reaction against frame structure beside the radial guide) that no inventor passage supplies. Per scope, Background prior-art characterizations were not traced and rendered images were not inspected.

findings.title: FIG. 5 brief anchors the carriage spring to "frame structure beside the radial guide", a mounting location and reaction relationship absent from the sources
findings.where: figures/FIG-5.md, final bullet of "Geometry to draw" (numeral 42, carriage spring)
findings.detail: The brief specifies not merely that a schematic spring biases the carriage outward but where it is grounded and how that ground sits circumferentially relative to the radial guide. The disclosed function (outward bias of each carriage) is supported, but no affirmative USER passage states any reaction point, attachment, or its position beside the guide. There is no affirmative passage anywhere in input/disclosure.md or the USER passage of input/conversation.md that describes where the carriage spring reacts; the nearest source passages address only the bias direction. The Detailed Description is likewise silent on any anchor, so the brief is adding a connection and relative location that the application text does not carry. The remaining content of the same bullet (zigzag depiction, radial line of action, outward bias toward the outer end of the guide) is supported and should be preserved.
findings.evidence: Candidate (figures/FIG-5.md): "A spring drawn as a short zigzag line acting between the carriage and frame structure beside the radial guide, shown schematically, the zigzag lying parallel to the radial guide so that its line of action is radial and biases the carriage outward, that is toward the upper end of the radial guide." Nearest inventor passage (input/disclosure.md): "A spring biases each carriage outward when the latch is released." Application text (draft/08-detailed-description.md): "A carriage spring 42 biases each jaw carriage 22 outward, away from the central axis of the closed frame." Neither passage discloses a reaction point, an attachment to frame structure, or any position of that structure relative to the radial guide.
findings.fix: In figures/FIG-5.md, replace the spring bullet with: "- A spring drawn as a short zigzag line acting between the carriage and the frame, shown schematically, the zigzag lying parallel to the radial guide so that its line of action is radial and biases the carriage outward, that is toward the upper end of the radial guide." No change is needed to draft/07-drawings.md, draft/08-detailed-description.md, draft/09-claims.md, or draft/numerals.md, all of which are already anchor-neutral for numeral 42.
